annotations.title: Worthy Value Stocks to Consider Now

content.text:
I can’t give personalized financial advice, but **if you’re asking “what should I buy now?” my default answer is: buy mostly broad-market ETFs, then add a few high-quality stocks only if you can hold 5+ years.**

## Simple “buy now” shortlist

### 1. **Best core buy: S&P 500 ETF**
**VOO** or **SPY**  
- Current VOO price: about **$681.91** as of June 8, 2026.   
- Good if you want simple U.S. large-cap exposure.
- Better than trying to guess the single best stock.

### 2. **Quality large-cap stocks to consider**
These are not “guaranteed winners,” but they are strong long-term businesses:

| Stock | Why consider it | Current snapshot |
|---|---|---|
| **MSFT** | Cloud, AI, enterprise software, strong cash flow | Around **$412.19**, P/E about **24.5**  |
| **GOOGL** | Search, YouTube, cloud, AI; still reasonably valued vs. mega-cap peers | Around **$364.01**, P/E about **27.8**  |
| **AMZN** | AWS, ads, e-commerce margin growth | Around **$243.56**, P/E about **29.1**  |
| **BRK.B** | Diversified, cash-rich, defensive quality | Around **$487.83**, P/E about **14.3**  |

### 3. **If you want value exposure**
Consider a value ETF rather than picking one beaten-down name:
- **VTV** — Vanguard Value ETF  
- **SCHD** — dividend/value-tilted ETF  
- **AVUV** — U.S. small-cap value ETF, higher risk

Recent market commentary has pointed to value stocks as potentially attractive after growth-stock strength, but value often requires patience. ([kiplinger.com](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/value-stocks/worthy-value-stocks-to-consider-now?utm_source=openai))

## My suggested allocation if you’re unsure

For a long-term investor:

- **70% VOO or VTI**
- **10% SCHD or VTV**
- **10% MSFT / GOOGL / AMZN split**
- **10% cash or short-term Treasury fund**

If you’re younger and can handle volatility, you could increase the stock allocation. If you need the money within 1–3 years, don’t put much of it in stocks.

## What I would avoid

- Chasing tiny “top stock for June 2026” names.
- Buying solely because analysts say “Strong Buy.”
- Putting all your money into AI, crypto-related stocks, or one hot sector.
- Buying before you have an emergency fund.

## Best answer in one line

If you want the simplest move: **buy VOO or VTI regularly, and add MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, or BRK.B only as smaller satellite positions.**
